summary: PR 3014 is valid test-only hardening and an honest negative result, not a production fix. Its tests pass, while the original mapped plain-loader layout mismatch remains reproducible with an empty AssertionError on CPU and gfx950 at both the recorded base and exact candidate commit.

tests.what_was_measured: At base 358c1632, mapped img_in.weight with incompatible layout raised an empty AssertionError on CPU and gfx950; BF16-style exact-name to_q.weight used the identity path.
At the recorded base, the candidate's two test-only regressions passed, showing they do not distinguish the unresolved production behavior.
At exact candidate f5be8cec, both fused-QKV and matching runtime-layout regression tests passed.
At exact candidate f5be8cec, the mapped incompatible layout still raised the empty AssertionError on CPU and gfx950, and exact-name BF16-style Q used the identity path.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent base and candidate executions used cuda:0 on AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and reproduced the mapped-layout AssertionError.

remaining_counterexamples: A diffusers/BFL img_in.weight mapped to x_embedder.weight still reaches the ordinary two-argument loader without layout reconciliation and can raise the original empty shape AssertionError.
BF16 FLUX.2 separate to_q/to_k/to_v exact-name parameters take the identity path and do not exercise the fused-QKV regression.
The secondary FSDP text-encoder name mismatch and real-checkpoint silent drops are not covered or fixed.
The ROCm update_weights_from_disk standalone test remains explicitly skipped pending issue 31924.
remaining_limitations: Qwen-Image and FLUX.2-klein-base-4B weights were unavailable, so the historical full-model HTTP 400 was not replayed and the exact real failing tensor remains unidentified.
The synthetic transposed fixture proves absence of generic layout reconciliation but does not prove that transpose or any particular reshape is correct for a real checkpoint.
FSDP/DTensor text-encoder reload, layerwise offload, tensor parallel, multi-GPU, and multi-node behavior were not qualified.
No production or native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
